evidence.reason: At current tip, `reviewOk` line 72 checks only `initialBlocking === null` before calling `.every(...)`. An absent (`undefined`) or non-array value therefore throws a `TypeError` instead of returning false. `admit()` calls `ok(row)` unguarded and, per its header (lines 94–97), expects malformed rows to be routed to the unknown list; this exception escapes and aborts `computeOutcomePanels`. The adjacent `findingFingerprints` check already uses `Array.isArray`, showing the intended type guard pattern. The line remains vulnerable in the supplied current source, so this is an ordinary implementation defect, not a request to enlarge scope.
